Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,100.90 down -29.80 points May 02, 2018, 04:45:16 PM EDT By NASDAQ.com News Shutterstock photo
Wednesday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,100.90. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.2 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 1.14 to 1 ratio. There were 1573 advancers and 1377 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 42 stocks reached a 52 week high and 24 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -.56% for the day; a total of -37.48 points. The current value is 6,644.48. Gilead Sciences, Inc. ( GILD ) had the largest percent change down (-7.83%) while Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change gain rising 4.42%. The Dow Jones index closed down -.72% for the day; a total of -174.07 points. The current value is 23,924.98. Verizon Communications Inc.
